neighbours.label: ' a' or ' an' after a verb of filing something formal with an organization (submit a claim, lodge an inquiry, file a complaint), plus ' filed' itself; the same articles after everyday verbs stay low
fire: If the box arrives damaged, please submit a claim within ten days.
Our office may lodge a complaint with the airline.
Customers can file a report through the bank's website.
The union has filed formal notice against the company.
You may also submit an appeal to the housing board.
To get a refund, please open a ticket with our support team.
The tenants decided to lodge an objection with the council.
Anyone can file an application at the town hall.
quiet: If the box arrives early, please bake a cake within ten days.
Our cat may catch a mouse near the airline office.
Customers can buy a coffee at the bank's cafe.
The union has held a picnic near the company.
You may also pick an apple at the housing farm.
To get a tan, please rent a chair near our pool.
The tenants decided to paint an old wall near the council.
Anyone can eat an orange at the town hall.

short: submit a claim / file a complaint
